build_external_mask_extension: build the Cython extension external._mask from C and Pyx source files using setup.py
run_setup_py_install: run setup.py to install the external package with the compiled mask extension
compile_cython_extension: compile the Cython extension module external._mask with C99 standard and numpy headers
customize_extension_compile_args: customize the extension compile arguments to suppress warnings and set C standard
cythonize_setup_extensions: cythonize the Extension objects in setup.py to generate C source for the mask module
